title: Academic case reports lack diversity: Assessing the presence and diversity of sociodemographic and behavioral factors related to Post COVID-19 Condition
reasoning: The paper includes 'Spiritual Beliefs' as one of the 26 core entity types it uses to benchmark its NER and NLI models. It specifically evaluates the model's ability to extract and reason about religious identities (e.g., 'Is christian or catholic') and identifies a significant underrepresentation of these factors in the analyzed clinical reports.
